description: MANDATORY BEFORE CALLING: the user must have chosen BOTH sport and format for THIS tournament. If either is missing, ask instead of generating, or call get_supported_tournament_options to discover choices. Never infer sport or format from unrelated previous conversations, previous tool use, player/court counts or a default. 'Make a tournament for 20 players on four courts' requires clarification, not an Americano. Reuse choices explicitly confirmed earlier in this same tournament setup. Clarify individuals versus fixed teams when ambiguous. For PICKLEBALL only: generate singles, fixed-team or rotating-doubles round-robin fixtures. Establish sport first; offer pickleball round robin or knockout, and padel Americano or Mexicano. Before calling, establish singles vs fixed teams vs rotating partners, whether the count means players or teams, full round robin vs a limited number of rounds, match duration and available session time. Never infer fixed teams from an individual player count. A full singles/fixed-team draw has n*(n-1)/2 matches and may require multiple court waves per round. Pickleball rotating partners use mode rotating_doubles here, with a numeric round count, not generate_americano. Do not promise everyone meets everyone in rotating doubles. Always show the returned fixtures in full, round by round; never replace them with a summary. Return total matches and estimated session length; if it exceeds the user's time, discuss a shorter partial draw rather than silently changing format. Free draft only; no saving or publishing.

count.description: Confirmed entrant count: individual players for singles or rotating doubles, complete teams for fixed doubles. Never silently divide a player count into teams; confirm the format and team count first.

durationMinutes.description: Confirmed match duration in minutes, including any changeover allowance. Ask rather than silently assuming 20 minutes.

mode.description: Required pickleball choice: singles, fixed doubles teams or rotating doubles with individual players. Ask when unspecified. Keep pickleball rotating doubles here; Americano is the padel tool.

names.description: Optional player names, or team names for fixed doubles. Supply exactly count names, or omit for numbered placeholders. Do not include contact details.

rounds.description: Required schedule choice. For rotating doubles, supply a numeric round count. Use auto only when the user wants a full singles or fixed-team round robin; a number limits the draw to that many rounds. Confirm full versus shorter play and available session time before choosing.

seed.description: Keep this value unchanged to reproduce a draw; change it only when requesting a new draw.

sport.description: Confirmed sport. NextArena offers pickleball round robin and knockout brackets; ask for the sport if missing.

startTime.description: Local start time in HH:MM, 24-hour format.
